name: TokenHolder
fix_description: In sell, all security checks are commented out: whitelist validation for DEX, router, collateral token, and approval amount. Uncomment and enforce these require statements to prevent arbitrary token extraction via unvalidated parameters.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, single-call exploit that abuses protocol logic by passing attacker-controlled addresses and calldata into sell(), with mocked callbacks/functions on the attacker contract. It does not require flash loans, price manipulation, or deep DeFi knowledge beyond spotting missing validation/trust assumptions in external call flow.
